name: Wurrzag da Great Green Prophet
canonNotes: A Savage Orc Great Shaman who channels the Waaagh! of Gork and Mork, wearing a strange mask and bone fetishes.
Unpredictable and mystical, he believes the gods speak directly through him.
voiceNotes: Rambling, mystical and wild; talks of visions, Gork and Mork.
Friendly one moment, frenzied the next.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
